svg.title: Popping from the heap: sift down
svg.desc: Pop returns 1. The last value 9 moves to the root and sinks 0 to 1 to 3, swapping with the smaller child each time (2, then 5). Result [2, 5, 3, 9, 6, 4, 8], two swaps.
svg.text: pop returns 1 · 9 moved to root · kids 2, 3; 9 > 2: swap
idx 3 has no children (7 > 6): done, 2 swaps
